landing.heroDescription: Turn rosbag data into diagnostic evidence. AI suggests causes and corrective actions while engineers retain decision authority.

workflowSteps.title: Upload rosbag
workflowSteps.description: Extract metadata, validate files and filter sensitive data.

workflowSteps.title: Analyze anomalies
workflowSteps.description: Inspect frequency, packet loss, timestamps, TF and silent topics.

workflowSteps.title: Investigate with Agent
workflowSteps.description: Review evidence, ask questions and validate root-cause hypotheses.

workflowSteps.title: Review & export
workflowSteps.description: An engineer confirms findings before sharing PDF or Markdown reports.

landing.rolesKicker: THE RIGHT PERSON. THE RIGHT ACCESS.

roles.title: Robotics Engineer
roles.description: Analyze rosbags, inspect anomaly hypotheses, attach evidence and review official reports.

roles.title: Administrator
roles.description: Manage accounts, assign access by robotics project and monitor system audit logs.

roles.title: Viewer
roles.description: View authorized diagnostic reports without modifying source data.
